newsitem.title: INDIA: India winter oilseed crop seen at 12.7 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India winter oilseed crop seen at 12.7 mln tonnes.

text.p: India's winter oilseed output in 1996/97 (November-October) is estimated at 12.7 million tonnes against a target of 12.4 million, Agriculture Minister Chaturanan Mishra said on Tuesday.
Mishra told the Indian Parliament the current year's oilseed production was around 700,000 tonnes higher than last year's winter output of 12.01 million tonnes.
India harvests two oilseed crops annually, with the bulk of its output from the winter crop. The winter crop is sown in July and harvested from October.
But trade estimates project this year's winter crop at 11.91 million tonnes, only marginally up from 11.43 million last year.
Mishra expected the summer oilseed crop production target of 9.5 million tonnes would be "achieved in full".
Industry estimates put the summer output at around 10 million against 9.55 million last year.
India's Oilseeds Production Programme plans to increase domestic oilseed production and cut down imports of edible oil, Mishra said.

The programme covers 337 districts in 22 states and would include financial assistance, distribution of seeds, improved production and crop protection technologies, he added. --New Delhi newsroom +91-11 301 2024
